ucs.title: [LLM] Peach Sandstorm (APT33) low-and-slow Entra ID password spray into valid cloud account
ucs.description: Detects the large-scale, low-and-slow password-spray campaigns Microsoft attributes to Peach Sandstorm / HOLMIUM (APT33): a single source touching many distinct Entra ID accounts with invalid-credential failures (error 50126) and landing at least one success in the same window. This is the actor's signature 2023-2024 initial-access vector against defense, satellite, aerospace and pharma tenants.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true dc(Authentication.user) as failed_users count as failures from datamodel=Authentication.Authentication where Authentication.action=failure by Authentication.src _time span=1h
| where failed_users >= 20
| join type=inner Authentication.src [
    | tstats summariesonly=true count as successes values(Authentication.user) as success_users from datamodel=Authentication.Authentication where Authentication.action=success by Authentication.src
  ]
| where successes > 0
| eval risk_note="distinct-user spray + success from same src (APT33/Peach Sandstorm pattern)"
| sort - failed_users
| table _time Authentication.src failed_users failures successes success_users risk_note
ucs.kql:
let SprayWindow = 1d;
let DistinctUserThreshold = 20;   // P99 of legit per-IP failed-user fan-out in 90d baseline; spray runs 100s
AADSignInEventsBeta
| where Timestamp > ago(SprayWindow)
| where isnotempty(IPAddress)
| summarize
    FailedUsers   = dcountif(AccountUpn, ErrorCode == "50126"),   // 50126 = invalid username/password
    TotalFailures = countif(ErrorCode == "50126"),
    Successes     = countif(ErrorCode == "0"),
    SuccessUsers  = make_set_if(AccountUpn, ErrorCode == "0", 50),
    LegacyAuth    = make_set_if(ClientAppUsed, ClientAppUsed has_any ("Other clients","BAV2ROPC","IMAP","POP","SMTP"), 10),
    Apps          = make_set(Application, 20),
    UAs           = make_set(UserAgent, 10),
    Countries     = make_set(Country, 10)
    by IPAddress, bin(Timestamp, 1h)
| where FailedUsers >= DistinctUserThreshold and Successes > 0
| order by FailedUsers desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let SprayWindow = 1d;
let DistinctUserThreshold = 20;
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(SprayWindow)
| where isnotempty(IPAddress)
| summarize
    FailedUsers   = dcountif(UserPrincipalName, ResultType == "50126"),
    TotalFailures = countif(ResultType == "50126"),
    Successes     = countif(ResultType == "0"),
    SuccessUsers  = make_set_if(UserPrincipalName, ResultType == "0", 50),
    LegacyAuth    = make_set_if(ClientAppUsed, ClientAppUsed has_any ("Other clients","BAV2ROPC","IMAP","POP","SMTP"), 10),
    Apps          = make_set(AppDisplayName, 20),
    UAs           = make_set(UserAgent, 10)
    by IPAddress, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where FailedUsers >= DistinctUserThreshold and Successes > 0
| order by FailedUsers desc
ucs.rationale: Generic brute-force rules alert on per-account lockouts; this is tuned to APT33's documented low-and-slow style — a single source spraying a wide breadth of distinct accounts (dcount of users, not failure count) and the requirement that at least one success lands in the same IP/hour bucket, which is the exact behavior Microsoft published for Peach Sandstorm's 2023 spray wave. ucs.title: [LLM] Peach Sandstorm (APT33) MFA/device-registration persistence following a risky sign-in
ucs.description: Hunts the persistence step Microsoft tied to Peach Sandstorm / Refined Kitten (APT33) after a successful password spray: the actor registers their own MFA method or joins a rogue device to the compromised cloud identity to retain access. Correlates an Entra security-info / device-registration audit event with a recent risky or anomalous sign-in for the same principal.
ucs.splunk:
index=azure_ad (sourcetype="azure:aad:audit" OR sourcetype="mscs:azure:audit") (operationName="User registered security info" OR operationName="User registered all required security info" OR operationName="Register device" OR operationName="Add registered device" OR operationName="Add a device")
| rename properties.targetResources{}.userPrincipalName as target_user, callerIpAddress as reg_ip
| join type=inner target_user [
    search index=azure_ad sourcetype="azure:aad:signin" (properties.riskLevelDuringSignIn=high OR properties.riskLevelDuringSignIn=medium OR properties.riskState=atRisk)
    | rename properties.userPrincipalName as target_user
    | stats values(callerIpAddress) as risky_ips by target_user
  ]
| stats min(_time) as firstTime values(operationName) as ops values(reg_ip) as reg_ip values(risky_ips) as risky_ips by target_user
| convert ctime(firstTime)
| sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let lookback = 7d;
let RiskySignins = AADSignInEventsBeta
    | where Timestamp > ago(lookback)
    | where RiskLevelDuringSignIn in ("high","medium") or RiskState =~ "atRisk"
    | distinct AccountObjectId, IPAddress, Country;
CloudAppEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(lookback)
| where ActionType in~ ("User registered security info","User registered all required security info","Register device","Add registered device","Add registered owner to device")
| join kind=inner RiskySignins on $left.AccountObjectId == $right.AccountObjectId
| project Timestamp, AccountDisplayName, AccountObjectId, ActionType, RegIP = IPAddress, RegCountry = CountryCode, ISP, UserAgent, RiskySigninIP = IPAddress1, RiskySigninCountry = Country
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let lookback = 7d;
let RiskySignins = SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
    | where RiskLevelDuringSignIn in ("high","medium") or RiskState =~ "atRisk"
    | distinct UserId, IPAddress;
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where OperationName in~ ("User registered security info","User registered all required security info","Register device","Add registered device","Add a device","Add registered owner to device")
| extend TargetUserId = tostring(TargetResources[0].id)
| extend ActorIP = tostring(parse_json(tostring(InitiatedBy.user)).ipAddress)
| join kind=inner RiskySignins on $left.TargetUserId == $right.UserId
| project TimeGenerated, OperationName, TargetUserId, ActorIP, RiskySigninIP = IPAddress, Result, ResultReason
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Entra ID MFA or device registration (APT33/Peach Sandstorm persistence)
id: 8c2f5a41-7b3e-4d8a-9f1c-6a2e4b9d1c33
status: experimental
description: New MFA security-info or device registration in Entra ID, a Peach Sandstorm (APT33) persistence step after account compromise. Pair with a recent risky sign-in for the same principal to reduce FPs.
logsource:
  product: azure
  service: auditlogs
detection:
  selection:
    OperationName:
      - 'User registered security info'
      - 'User registered all required security info'
      - 'Register device'
      - 'Add registered device'
      - 'Add a device'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate first-time MFA enrollment / new corporate device onboarding
level: medium
tags:
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1098.005
  - attack.t1556.006
  - attack.g0064
ucs.datadog_query: source:azure.activeDirectory @evt.name:("User registered security info" OR "User registered all required security info" OR "Register device" OR "Add registered device" OR "Add a device")
ucs.rationale: Device/MFA registration is noisy on its own (legit onboarding), so this is scoped as a hunt that chains the registration event to a recent risky/anomalous sign-in for the same object ID — the precise post-spray persistence sequence Microsoft documented for Peach Sandstorm (registering attacker-controlled MFA to maintain access into the compromised tenant).
